deferredNativeProofs.reason: All 16 current authored round-stroke icon assets ingest and run on GPU; 36,864 browser membership comparisons and 576 GPU controls retained as finite diagnostics. Independent direct stroke union supports 105/106 outline/browser disagreement points in favor of the outline, one in favor of original browser at 1x. Exact general stroke/boolean tolerances, robust singular normals, arbitrary SVG styles/transforms, portability and exact browser glyph shaping remain open.

Live Clear and Regular variable-blur compute dispatches and complete mip textures recovered; independent mathematical replay matches all 11 textures across four captured native cases. Exact 13-tap weights and finite copy/downsample arithmetic validated. Unrestricted public scale/radius, crop, source capture, level and branch selection still open (LG-P-SCALARS).

15,992 independent copy/even-mip channels and 2,068 native odd BGRA8 mip channels exact in software; 24,576 native linear and 98,304 native trilinear BGRA8 lanes matched by integer WebGPU. Signed-half arbitrary sampling and full native program equivalence remain open (LG-SR-NATIVE).
LG-Q-NUMERICAL remains open; runtime color and EDR chain not established.

Offscreen local event control delivered hover enter/move/exit, but interactive and noninteractive Clear had identical model/presentation and output-hash sequence. Genuine active native interaction state, hover/click/release operator not recovered.

Four native Clear/Regular intermediate-resource chains now reproduced mathematically byte-for-byte with captured input and ABI. Offscreen output stripe classes retained. Equivalent final fragment/material and active-display output lineage is not established.

Fixed-source GPU prefix integration passes finite CPU comparisons and accelerates a 128-query large-footprint benchmark; memory overhead, large artwork binding budgets, full-frame performance, 16 moving surfaces, overlap, scroll/route transitions and production regression validation remain open.
